confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from five web searches (Numbeo-derived figures via Expatica dated June 2026, Idealista, and a few single-venue menus), converted from euros at an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.16 that I did not look up. Restaurant meals, beer and coffee are reasonably well supported. Cocktail is the weakest: I found only one venue, an Aperol spritz at about EUR 6.50, so I estimated typical bar cocktails at roughly 2.3x the beer price. Wine by the glass is a blend of bodega prices (EUR 1.50-2.50) and wine bar or restaurant prices (EUR 4 and up). Accommodation figures are holistic estimates from general knowledge for a hot July low season in Córdoba. I did not search accommodation prices or inspect any listings. The RBA rate comes from a search summary of RBA pages, which also surfaced older, inconsistent figures that I disregarded.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored on Córdoba's own Numbeo-derived prices, which are lower than Madrid or Barcelona and similar to Seville and Granada. Accommodation is based on mid-sized Andalusian heritage cities in July, which is off-peak for Córdoba compared with spring.
